input.summary: Insert reciprocal transition-assistance and Licensee data return/deletion obligations into Article XXI (Effect of Termination).
input.comment: [Playbook] Article XXI only requires us to return Licensor materials and says nothing about our own trade and account data, so we have added a reciprocal exit provision: up to six months of transition assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, return of Licensee Data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is too long, we can accept ninety days of assistance provided the thirty-day data export and deletion certificate remain.

ops.text: (c) TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF LICENSEE DATA. Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (i) at Licensee's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, return to Licensee all data of or relating to Licensee, its customers and its trades that is stored in or processed by the Licensed Technology ("Licensee Data") in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete all Licensee Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing to Licensee. Licensor shall not withhold, suspend access to, or delete any Licensee Data except in accordance with this Section, and this Section shall survive termination of this Agreement.
